study type: Feasibility pilot study with a mixed-method approach
exposure: mobile application based on the Confident birth method
cohort: The study included 48 women, with 24 iPhone-users testing the app during pregnancy and 24 forming a control group.
finding: The app was perceived as useful and appreciated by women with excellent system usability (mean score 85.3), though preliminary effects on early labour or childbirth experience showed no significant differences compared to the control group.
